status.en: 17 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 47% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Sweida.
status.nb: 17 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 47 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Sweida.

summary.en: Syrian security forces have again foiled a Hezbollah-linked plot to attack the Homs oil refinery, accusing the group of planning a bomb attack. Israeli airstrikes have struck southern Syria, causing civilian casualties. Saudi and Syrian leaders met and warned that renewed military escalation could threaten global security and the economy, while Damascus is considering joining the Mecca Pact. The conflict continues to generate high fatalities, with 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker har igjen avverget et Hezbollah-tilknyttet plot mot Homs oljeraffineri, og anklager gruppen for å planlegge et bombeangrep. Israels luftangrep har truffet sørlige Syria og forårsaket sivile tap. Saudiske og syriske ledere møttes og advarte om at en ny militær opptrapping kan true global sikkerhet og økonomi, mens Damaskus vurderer å bli med i Mekka-pakt. Konflikten fortsetter å gi høye dødstall, med 2 732 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
